envelope.description: Validate selected-change packets and ordinary task results

body.title: Validate selected-change packets and ordinary task results
body.summary: Add the minimal S1-owned sc1/sc2/sc3 types and validators, committed document/change lookup and derived task assignments. Keep the submitted file/segment selection authoritative; commits are lookup pointers. Validate ordinary findings, coverage strength, limitations and advice without introducing ledger aliases or proof machinery.
acceptanceChecks: Selected segments resolve through their supplied commit/parent pointers; unrelated same-commit changes never enter scope, and no final/head commit is required.
Committed Story/LLD/Plan and complete tests are validated once; assignments derive task order, S/M/L size and attribution from pinned inputs without losing selected changes.
Ordinary task-result validation prevents an empty findings list or missing evidence from becoming a false pass; optional advice remains separate.
Types retain a single attempt collection and version-2 CR distinction; no additional persisted authority or coding/build-validation changes.

tests.name: selected-change packet: commit pointers, exact ranges, committed documents and excluded same-commit changes
derived tasks: pinned dependencies, S/M/L sizes and complete selected-change attribution
ordinary results: required evidence, coverage strength, supported severity and nonblocking advice
